name: Sapphire
description: Rocky Patel Sapphire is the latest release in the brand’s jewel-inspired series. It features a Mexican San Andrés wrapper with aged Nicaraguan fillers from Estelí, Jalapa, and Condega, along with binders from Nicaragua and Honduras. Made with six-to-seven-year-aged tobaccos grown largely on Rocky Patel’s own farms, it delivers a richer medium-to-full bodied profile.
